system.description: Also called the Words of Exile, this ritual is spoken as five syllables in an unidentifiable, possibly antediluvian language. Casting takes one turn and requires spending one Willpower Trait and one Blood Trait (neither guarantees success). On success, it tears a hole in reality within the Necromancer's own body, visible only via Shroudsight as a black vortex. Any wraith (spirito or spettro) clutched to the caster's chest via a successful Clinch or Tackle is instantly dispersed to Hell, unable to return for at least a month (and possibly never; a destroyed spirito often returns as a spettro, if it returns at all). The Necromancer may clutch and destroy a number of spirits equal to her successes before the vortex closes (it also closes automatically at scene's end). She may keep the vortex open by sacrificing one unsoakable lethal health level per turn it remains open, including the first. Every use of Esilio permanently costs one Morality/Humanity Trait.
system.source: Clanbook: Giovanni, Chapter Two: It Runs in the Family
